title: Hⁿ-measure of a closed ball in an n-dimensional linear subspace
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim Q = n. Then for every real r ≥ 0, Hⁿ(Q ∩ B̄_r(0)) = rⁿ ωₙ, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] (Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure) and ωₙ = unitBallVolume n = Lⁿ(B₁(0) ⊂ ℝⁿ); in ℝ≥0∞: μHE[n](Q ∩ closedBall 0 r) = ENNReal.ofReal (rⁿ) · unitBallVolume n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → μHE[n] ((Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ closedBall 0 r) = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * unitBallVolume n
